cash.title: What you need to have ready
cash.overdueNote: Includes {amount} already overdue from orders whose estimated arrival has passed.
cash.upcomingMonthsHelper: Upcoming obligations by estimated payment date.
cash.upcomingMonthsEmpty: No upcoming obligations with an estimated date.
cash.paidVsPendingChartLabel: Of the committed total {committed}, paid {paid} and pending {pending}
cash.noDateNote: Plus {amount} in orders with no estimated arrival date, informational and outside the monthly totals.
cash.partialWarning: {count, plural, one {# order saved its exchange rate against a different base currency} other {# orders saved their exchange rate against a different base currency}}. Their balances stay out of these totals until you reconcile them, so the figures are partial.

empty.title: You owe nothing right now
empty.body: Once you log orders with pending payments, you'll see here what you need to have ready each month: totals, overdue amounts, and upcoming due dates.

budget.title: This cycle
budget.cycleHelper: Spent in the current cycle (resets on day {day}).
budget.cycleHelperLastDay: Spent in the current cycle (resets on the last day of the month).
budget.overHatchCaption: The diagonal hatch marks the overage even if you can't tell the colors apart.
budget.partialNote: Only orders with a reconciled exchange rate count, so this figure is partial.
budget.notConfiguredBody: Set a monthly cap and we'll warn you with color as you get close. Without a budget there's no percentage to show.
budget.firstRunBody: You haven't set a monthly budget yet. Set a cap and we'll warn you with color as you get close.

empty.title: No upcoming payments
